title: Volcanoes of Indonesia (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Indonesia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Wolo Inelika
rounds.fact: Wolo Inelika is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,559 m in the source data. The data places it in Indonesia.
